 Madura United defeated Persib Bandung 1-0
 22nd October 2026 22:22 GMT+7
 Persib Bandung footballer Rosembergne Da Silva (second from left) kicked the ball towards Madura United goalkeeper Angga Saputro (left) during the BRI Super League match at Gelora Madura Ratu Pamelingan Stadium, Pamekasan, East Java, Thursday (22/10/2026). Madura United defeated Persib Bandung with a final score of 1-0. ANTARA FOTO/Rizal Hanafi/wsj.
